items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: INTERVIEWER: 'And you said you'd moved here to New Orleans.' INTERVIEWEE: 'Yeah, he brought me here when I was about two months old.'

ctx.x: Already? Oh my God. 13th of November 1975. Let me get some papers together. And there's an interview with Henry Roland Byrd. And what are we going to talk about? See, Fester, something I always wanted to ask you. I know you were born in Bugaloosa up there. And you said you'd moved here to New Orleans.
Yeah, he brought me here when I was about two months old.
